svg.title: SQL at a glance, with a learning order and an example query
svg.desc: Mind map of SQL. The centre says SQL. Seven branches: DQL (ask questions of the data: SELECT, FROM with joins, WHERE, GROUP BY, HAVING, ORDER BY, LIMIT) is the thickest because analysts use it every day. Operators and Functions are used often. DML (insert, update, delete rows) and DDL (create, alter, drop tables) are used sometimes. DCL (grant, revoke access) and TCL (begin, commit, rollback) are rarely used.
svg.text: how you ask a database questions
LINE THICKNESS = HOW MUCH AN ANALYST USES IT
